$smtpComment: Interim (Toby, 26 October 2026): mail goes through the existing SES account the live realm uses today (eu-west-1, opencouncil.network verified there), from admin@opencouncil.network, as today. Implicit TLS on 465 (ssl true, starttls false) is what the live realm does with no port set. Apply WITHOUT SMTP_USER/SMTP_PASSWORD: apply.mjs then keeps the user and password the live realm stores (mergeSmtpCredentials). The move to OCN's own account in eu-west-2, from ocn.technology, waits for SES production access there.
$comment: frontendUrl is https://auth.ocn.technology since release step F1, matching the fixed hostname in deploy/keycloak.conf.template. During the move it was empty, so each request got the issuer of the host it arrived on (docs/cut-over-runbook.md).
